diagnostics.checked_baseline_source: Historical RFC 0023 checked observation, same preserved executable and corpus manifest; not a fresh timing observation.

classification: All 3527 additions are checking-incomplete. Runtime initialized termination, memory intervals, promoted types, capacity, stream and cursor premises are now explicit.
Additional propagated incompleteness includes existing array, context, arithmetic, alias, object-view and iteration budgets. These remain visible and do not become completed contracts.
747 checking-incomplete diagnostics disappear, including unavailable callees and local initialization placeholders now handled by runtime and argument-list transfers.
No checking-failed diagnostic is added or removed. Ordinary diagnostic sets remain exactly identical in all three baseline and final repetitions.

diagnostic.message: 'buff', which may be null, is passed to 'quotefloat', which dereferences it

exception.assessment: The checked-mode witness disappears while quotefloat now exports a valid param 1 requirement. Both functions remain incomplete, and this is not counted as a newly proven caller or a demonstrated false-positive fix.

classification.reason: Five-second stack sampling followed by SIGINT of the verified analyzer process; this observation is excluded from cost signoff.

classification.classification: unprofiled 600-second observation; binary unchanged throughout; runtime validation harness was edited during this cost run and the wrapper caught that edit after measurement; the cost harness never invokes that edited script
longer diagnostic run with five-second stack profile; excluded from cost signoff

development_observations: Original source cases and expectations were frozen before checker implementation; transport and upstream clients were selected separately during implementation.
Supplemental include paths and a missing POSIX declaration were corrected before final runs. Earlier syntax failures are not counted as satisfied expectations.
List escape invalidation initially conflicted with the ordinary formatter fallback. That false rejection was fixed and changed C++ sources were forcibly rebuilt after the final edit.

The first sequential checked observation timed out on Lua at 600.149 seconds without a final report. Guard refinement now uses decisive scalar facts before its range/relation fallback; the limits were not changed.

A subsequent observation was converted to a five-second stack profile and interrupted. It is excluded from cost signoff. Profiling motivated bounded exact-call ledger reuse with insertion-order fallback near exhaustion.
Further observations timed out during expanded report writing. Expanded call paths now have a bounded write-local rendering cache, with exact JSON regression checks.

An additional stream review found that implicit output could follow fclose(stdout). The fix transports a named environmental precondition through helpers and rejects known closure or invalid replacement. Its regressions are supplemental to the frozen source population.
Strict lint required explicit arithmetic grouping in the report test and a size_t-typed cache bound. Both full suites were rerun after those final source edits.
Development passes and stale build observations are retained locally; final evidence is bound to the frozen source and executable hashes.
limits: Three of four unchanged-source runtime clients complete. cJSON_Compare with closed string operands retains a visible expected-acceptance miss because recursive object/container paths and memory premises remain.
The prior Jansson memory population retains its baseline strbuffer-lifecycle miss; its append contracts remain incomplete.
Complete corpus contracts remain conditional on exported entry requirements; they do not certify entire libraries or arbitrary callers.
Record-embedded or escaping va_list, direct va_arg, positional/wide formats, %n and unbound dynamic formats remain incomplete.
Unbounded formatting requires a represented upper output bound. A terminated-prefix fact does not initialize the full destination capacity.
